### Attribute and label names

Upstream label names are kept in the compat scope and replaced in the OTel
scope by the attribute each maps to.

| OTel attribute | Prometheus label |
| --- | --- |
| `db.namespace` | `database` |
| `pgbouncer.client.state` | `state` |
| `pgbouncer.database.alias` | `database` |
| `pgbouncer.user` | `user` |
| `server.address` | `host` |
| `server.port` | `port` |

### Metrics with no upstream counterpart

Surface this receiver adds beyond `pgbouncer_exporter`. These are not emitted
into the compat scope, because there is nothing to be compatible with.


- `db.client.connection.idle.min` (gauge, {connection}) — Server connections PgBouncer keeps open when idle.
